weight_semantics: Actual CUDA top-k weights, nonnegative and not renormalized; read sign and batch/head offsets removed.
gsu_gain_semantics: Each write event includes its effective GSU gain: alpha=(1-w)/(1-w+exp(gamma)*w), mass=alpha*previous_mass+w, gain=w/(mass+1e-12); slot=old_slot+gain*(input-old_slot).
selection_note: Exploratory visual ranking. Validation texts used for both descriptive metrics and example selection; selected examples are not an unbiased success-rate estimate.

head_selection_rules.subword_composition: Adjacent word-piece shared-slot strength, top-8 entropy concentration, and excess over ordinary word boundaries and punctuation-adjacent controls.
head_selection_rules.paired_punctuation: Discovery-frozen anchor slots; paired strength, top-8 entropy concentration, excess over nearby controls and ordinary word-piece pairs. Shared anchors permitted.
